profile.headline: Digital Experience + Platform Architect | Full-Stack Engineer | Design Systems · UX · Creative Strategy
profile.summary:
I design the systems behind digital experiences.

My work sits at the intersection of full-stack engineering, product design, accessibility, and platform architecture. Whether I’m shaping the overall approach, designing a workflow in Figma, writing React or PHP, integrating APIs, or untangling the infrastructure underneath, I focus on turning complex problems into sustainable solutions.

Over time, that has increasingly meant streamlining complicated experiences into reusable architectures, component libraries, and governance standards that give teams a clearer, more consistent foundation to work from while bringing structure to digital ecosystems as they scale. Accessibility, performance, maintainability, and thoughtful visual design are all part of that, creating systems that work well, look good, and can evolve without becoming harder to operate.

My background in graphic design and photography still strongly influences how I approach engineering and creative strategy. I care about the structure underneath a system and how it communicates and feels to the person using it. To me, code, UX, performance, accessibility, and visual design aren’t separate concerns in a pipeline. They’re interconnected parts of a well-designed experience.

I’m especially drawn to messy problems where technology, people, process, and experience all need to fit together. I enjoy finding the architecture hiding inside the complexity, then getting hands-on enough to make it real.

positions.title: Digital Experience & Platform Architect / Senior Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Design and engineer digital platforms and experiences across 25+ production web properties serving hundreds of thousands of monthly visitors. Work across full-stack development, platform architecture, UX, accessibility, and technical strategy, turning complex institutional requirements into maintainable systems while staying hands-on across development, integrations, APIs, and infrastructure.

• Architect and maintain a distributed web ecosystem spanning institutional, academic, center, program, campaign, and service experiences, creating reusable patterns for development, governance, accessibility, and content management.

• Design and develop Fuller’s shared digital design system and component architecture, creating reusable standards for accessibility, responsive behavior, consistency, and implementation across independently managed properties.

• Architect and engineer a governed publishing platform for 23+ institutional handbooks, policies, and reports, replacing fragmented documents with a single source of truth while retaining Google Docs for authoring. Built automated QA, role-based approvals, structured web publishing, versioning, and archival output.

• Advance accessibility across 25+ web properties by embedding WCAG-aligned components, development standards, and content patterns into the shared platform architecture.

• Work hands-on across performance, analytics and attribution, authentication, APIs, DNS, Cloudflare, caching, hosting, security, deployment, and production incident response.

• Partner with marketing, IT, academic and administrative teams, centers, vendors, and content owners to turn business and user needs into practical, sustainable technical solutions.

• Build governance, reusable tooling, and editor experiences that help distributed teams manage content independently while protecting accessibility, design standards, and platform integrity.

positions.title: Web Developer & Designer
positions.description:
Partnered with teams across Fuller’s institutional and center ecosystem to design, develop, and improve digital experiences spanning web development, UX/UI, branding, content architecture, and accessibility. The role grew from project-based design and development into broader responsibility for shared platforms, technical standards, and digital systems.

• Designed UX/UI concepts and high-fidelity prototypes alongside print and digital graphic design for institutional initiatives and centers, translating distinct program identities and audience needs into cohesive experiences across channels.

• Developed and customized WordPress websites, components, templates, and functionality, improving content architecture and editor workflows for distributed teams.

• Applied WCAG accessibility standards across design and front-end development, creating more inclusive and reusable patterns for content, interaction, navigation, and responsive experiences.

• Collaborated with marketing, communications, academic programs, centers, and other stakeholders to turn requirements into practical solutions balancing user needs, brand standards, accessibility, and technical constraints.

• Helped establish reusable development patterns and technical standards that became the foundation for broader shared-platform and design-system work across Fuller’s web ecosystem.
positions.insights: Software Development, Web Performance and +14 skills

positions.title: Digital Experience Consultant & Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Independent digital experience consultancy supporting businesses, nonprofits, arts organizations, and community institutions across creative strategy, product/UX design, full-stack development, and platform stewardship. My work has evolved from visual and web design into custom app development, technical SEO, integrations, accessibility, and platform strategy.

• Design and develop responsive, accessible experiences across WordPress, custom PHP/JS applications, e-commerce, and third-party integrations.

• Modernize platforms across UX/UI, information architecture, technical SEO, analytics, performance, accessibility, and content strategy.

• Build custom functionality, integrations, and workflows that solve operational problems and give nontechnical teams control over their systems.

• Design reusable content structures and editor experiences that make complex websites easier to maintain without rebuilding the underlying system.

• Work directly with clients from discovery and UX design through technical architecture, launch, and ongoing iteration.

Organizations I’ve worked with include:

Peoplescape — Long-term partnership spanning web strategy, UX, technical SEO, CMS optimization, and company-wide rebranding.

Centre Stage, Inc. — Website modernization, SEO, branding, and custom commerce supporting ticketing, registration, donations, and merchandise.

SoCal Arts — Digital strategy, UX, web development, e-commerce, streaming, and multimedia for digital and live performances.

Monrovia Days — Full-stack event app, website, visual identity, photography, marketing, and multimedia for a citywide community event.

Community Center of La Cañada Flintridge (CCLCF) — Platform strategy, UX, custom WordPress development, editor workflows, integrations, accessibility, SEO, and automation.

Solits Landscaping — Digital strategy, UX, web development, SEO, and platform modernization supporting customer acquisition.

positions.title: Web Developer & Product Designer
positions.description:
Long-term partnership supporting Dynamic Team Solutions and founder Candice Gottlieb-Clark’s author and speaking platform. My work spans web development, product design, UX, e-commerce, SEO, content management, integrations, multimedia, and ongoing platform strategy.

• Design, develop, and maintain responsive WordPress experiences across Dynamic Team Solutions and Gottlieb-Clark’s author platform, creating a cohesive digital foundation for consulting, books, thought leadership, speaking, and audience engagement.

• Architect scalable CMS structures and reusable content systems that make it easier to publish and manage evolving content without rebuilding the platform around each new initiative.

• Designed and built Gottlieb-Clark’s author platform to support the expansion of her work into books, speaking engagements, thought leadership, and digital content.

• Improve UX, content architecture, SEO, e-commerce, integrations, and performance as business and audience needs evolve, allowing the platforms to grow without becoming harder to manage.

• Manage digital workflows surrounding speaking engagements and content, including web publishing, multimedia production, and video editing, creating a more consistent process for publishing and promoting new material.

• Collaborate directly with the founder on new ideas and changing business needs, moving from concept and experience design through implementation and ongoing platform support.
positions.insights: Software Development, Systems Design and +23 skills

positions.title: Senior Product Designer & Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Led product design and full-stack development across National Energy Installers’ digital ecosystem, combining UX, application development, web architecture, analytics, accessibility, and design systems to support customer experiences and internal sales workflows.

• Designed and engineered customer-facing React applications that turned complex energy incentive and financial data into practical decision-making tools for customers and sales teams.

• Built an interactive tax credit and rebate map that enabled users to find geographically relevant government incentives, making complex program data easier to understand and act on.

• Designed and developed an investment tax credit and depreciation calculator that helped customers and sales teams evaluate the financial potential of commercial energy projects.

• Architected and launched a portfolio of responsive WordPress properties using reusable components and patterns, improving performance, SEO, conversion pathways, and long-term maintainability.

• Developed a scalable design system across websites and applications, creating shared visual, interaction, responsive, and accessibility standards that improved consistency and accelerated product development.

• Integrated WCAG accessibility into design and development workflows and mentored junior designers in accessible digital design.

• Used web analytics, user feedback, and A/B testing to identify friction points and make customer sign-ups and key workflows smoother.

projects.title: Institutional Handbook Publishing Platform
projects.description:
Architect and develop a distributed authoring and publishing platform that transforms Google Docs into structured, governed digital experiences.

Designed the system around existing author workflows while adding automated structural validation, proposal and approval workflows, role-based publishing, version management, archival publishing, structured content models, and accessible web presentation.

Built using Google Apps Script, JavaScript, React, REST-based integrations, Google Workspace APIs, and reusable web components.

The platform replaces fragmented document workflows with a governed publishing system that lets distributed teams manage complex handbook content independently while maintaining consistent structure, accessibility, versioning, and presentation.

projects.title: Fuller Digital Design System
projects.description:
Design and develop Fuller’s shared digital design system, creating reusable foundations for accessible, consistent, and maintainable experiences across institutional and center properties.

Established shared design tokens, typography, color, responsive behavior, component patterns, content structures, accessibility standards, and implementation guidance while preserving flexibility for distinct programs and audiences.

Built reusable components and implementation standards that give independently managed Fuller properties a shared foundation for accessibility, responsive behavior, visual consistency, and development, reducing duplicated work and fragmentation across the ecosystem.
